mapper.select: SELECT cp.card_name, cp.card_image_url, CONCAT('**** ', uc.first4) AS maskedCardNumber, COALESCE(SUM(pt.discount_amount), 0) AS totalDiscount, COALESCE(SUM(pt.amount), 0) AS totalSpend FROM user_card uc JOIN card_product cp ON uc.card_product_id = cp.card_product_id LEFT JOIN payment_transaction pt ON pt.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND DATE_FORMAT(pt.paid_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} WHERE uc.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND uc.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY cp.card_name, cp.card_image_url, uc.first4

SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, pt.paid_at AS approvedAt, br.brand_name AS storeName, ROUND(pt.discount_amount / pt.amount * 100, 0) AS discountRate, pt.amount AS paidAmount, pt.discount_amount AS benefitAmount FROM payment_transaction pt JOIN user_card uc ON pt.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id JOIN store s ON pt.store_id = s.store_id JOIN category c ON s.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN brand br ON s.brand_id = br.brand_id WHERE pt.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND uc.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(pt.paid_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} ORDER BY c.category_id, pt.paid_at DESC
